There are a variety of different fuels, available each with different characteristics. Each fuel has a §e[Flammable] and §6[Combustible] value.

The §e[Flammable] value corresponds to how much heat is gained from burning each fuel in either a [[fluid burner|Fluid Burner]] or [[flare stack|Flare Stack]].

The §6[Combustible] value is how much power can be gained from igniting each fluid. This can be done with the [[diesel generator|Diesel Generator]], the [[industrial combustion engine|Industrial Combustion Engine]], or the [[combined cycle gas turbine|Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]].

Each fuel is also associated with a combustion fuel grade. The fuel grade corresponds to which [[piston set|Piston Sets]] is the most efficient. There are five fuel grades available along with four [[piston sets|Piston Sets]] that have varying efficiencies. The piston set most optimal for each fuel can be used in an [[industrial combustion engine|Industrial Combustion Engine]] to generate power from the fuel.
